method: Node VM UI fixture execution of shipped scripts; all HTTP responses mocked; no Hyundai account or vehicle used

results.test: Helper-required setup blocks credentials and every programmatic login without direct fallback
Only a valid same-window helper hello enables credentials and Automatic uses the helper
Bundled Android page enables login immediately and exclusively uses native Hyundai transport
Native interface cannot be used on a public origin or an unexpected bundled path
Absent or incomplete native interface keeps bundled credentials locked even in Direct mode
Native exports pass only sanitized data and distinguish choosing a file from saving it
Native export rejection does not claim a file was written
Native stop cancels once, ignores late responses and never retries login
Native pagehide during enrollment redacts encoded email after secret memory is cleared
Pagehide retains redaction values until an aborted request logs opaque echoed secrets
Native timeout cancels the request and does not fall back or retry
Native callbacks ignore unknown identifiers and reject malformed or failed responses
Native transaction headers reach polling and command acceptance remains distinct from completion
Native command guard and sanitized start record are persisted before transmission
Native restart preserves unknown-command gate while allowing reads and explicit physical acknowledgement
Definitive native SUCCESS or ERROR clears guard, while pending and unknown polling preserve it
Cancelled confirmation, invalid climate, and unavailable storage never save or send a command
Malformed persisted guard remains conservative and acknowledgement cannot bypass a failed storage clear
Login, enrollment and cached status run in order and clear credentials
Logged login success followed by enrollment C500 preserves session and enables only a manual lookup test
HTTP 502 with IDM_401_1 identifies incorrect credentials and never enables the post-login lookup
Manual literal-at lookup reuses token and PIN once and remembers only a confirmed enrollment format
Failed or malformed alternate enrollment never retries or promotes the unconfirmed email format
Alternate lookup error text and its literal-at URL are sanitized before display, storage and export
Busy manual lookup disables competing actions and duplicate clicks produce only one GET
An expired session prevents the alternate lookup from sending a request and disables its button
Stopping or leaving a delayed alternate lookup rejects its late success without adopting the format or exposing identity
Cached-status failure cannot offer an unrelated alternate enrollment lookup
A later enrollment failure invalidates stale read status and withholds new commands
Saved and copied logs redact credentials, identifiers, coordinates and echoed secrets
Non-JSON authentication errors retain status without raw response text
Connection check after login sends no account identity, access token or service PIN
Empty HTTP 200 login does not invent an authenticated session or vehicle data
Malformed enrollment and status response shapes cannot enable vehicle commands
HTTP 429 stops the read sequence and never retries
CORS failure offers actionable helper instructions and sends no retry
Duplicate login submissions while busy produce only one request
Stop waiting aborts the request and never retries or preserves password
Accepted command without transaction ID stays unresolved and cannot be retried
Command is observed first and confirmed only after SUCCESS transaction result
Lights and horn/lights poll with their specific service type
Rereading enrollment after a command preserves polling for the same vehicle identifiers
Climate validation blocks unsafe or unknown engine settings before transmission
Browser helper rejects non-Hyundai, unknown endpoints, invalid methods and injectable headers
Browser helper ignores messages from other origins, windows or session channels
Browser helper honors cancellation and rejects third concurrent request
Browser helper suppresses response bodies after an unexpected cross-origin redirect
